name: Glass Shader
tagline: A landing-page hero with glass over the page: reeded, fogged, beaded with drops or frosted into tiles, bending what's behind it.
youSay: /glass-shader a launch page for Pane, privacy-first web analytics
whatYouGet: A landing page whose hero is glass over the page: full-page reeded glass, a fogged window you wipe, water drops on a photo, or a wall of frosted tiles over a glowing ball
Real refraction with nothing painted on: what's behind is magnified, squeezed, frosted and fringed, while the backdrop answers the cursor
The page around it: brand, copy, type and a layout made for the look, on wide screens, tall windows and phones
A static site with no libraries, plus a tool that generates a photo for the glass through your Skillsmart account
goodFit: Calm, architectural, natural or techy brands that want a premium, tactile first screen
Weather, sound, café, flower and energy products (the examples)
notFor: A 3D glass object as the hero (that's Glass Hero)
youBring: What the page is for and the brand name
Optional: a photo for the glass to sit over, colours, headline and fonts
needs: Node 18+ and Skillsmart credits only to generate a photo (20 each)

generates.estimate: 20 per photo, only if you generate one
